subject: MedScribe trial runbook + scorer alignment
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@medsprint.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: MedScribe trial runbook + scorer alignment

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we have a single source of truth for the trial run:

1) Goal: run a 2-week model-fit trial to validate MedScribe’s transcription + clinical extraction use case on 5k representative notes (mix of encounter, discharge, and consult). Key success metrics:
   - Extraction precision >= 92% on top 10 entities
   - Summary BLEU-like score improvement over current baseline by >= 12%
   - No PII leakage and compliant with our retention policy

2) Redwood deliverables (what we’ll provision):
   - Hosted trial endpoint with model variants (open LLM 13B quant and 7B quant)
   - Eval harness + scorer that runs nightly on incoming batches
   - Prefix/KV cache and batching tuned to preserve <200ms per-token p95

3) What we need from MedScribe by EOD Thu (2027-08-19):
   - 200 sample notes (anonymized) in the attached CSV format (see medscribe_eval_dataset_sample.csv)
   - Priority entity list and example golden labels (CSV)
   - A short prompt set (we attached medscribe_prompt_bank_v1.md) and a couple of hard negative examples

4) Scoring & quality guardrails:
   - We’ll run exact-match and relaxed span scoring for entities, plus a human-reviewed sample for summary quality.
   - Regression alerts will be fired if average entity precision drops by >4% week-over-week.

5) Timeline & next steps:
   - You send samples by Thu 8/19 -> we ingest + validate by 8/20
   - Warmup evaluation (sanity run) on 8/21 -> internal review 8/23
   - Kickoff for customer-facing run 8/24 (2 weeks) -> final readout week of 9/6

Attachments: medscribe_eval_dataset_sample.csv, medscribe_prompt_bank_v1.md, redwood-onramp-checklist.pdf (links below).

Do you confirm the requirements above and the timeline? If yes, can we lock in a 30-minute kickoff on Tue 8/24 at 10:00am PT?

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193

--
Internal note: CCing Ben and Marissa to track scoring configuration and the customer ask for entity priority list.
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@medsprint.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedScribe Technical <eng@medsprint.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedScribe trial runbook + scorer alignment

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the crisp recap. Confirming on MedScribe side:

- We will deliver the 200 anonymized notes by Thu 8/19 COB.
- Attached is a small internal mapping of our entity taxonomy (we'll send formal golden labels soon).
- 8/24 10:00am PT works for the kickoff — adding Eng (cc'd) to the calendar.

Two quick clarifications:
1) For the nightly scorer, can you support a custom F1 weighting that emphasizes precision on medication entities? That matters more to our clinical reviewers.
2) Any constraints on file encoding or column headers for the CSV? We will try to match your sample exactly but want to avoid validation rework.

Olivia
Olivia Chen
Head of Product, MedSprint
olivia@medsprint.ai | +1 415-555-2233

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@medsprint.ai>, MedScribe Technical <eng@medsprint.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedScribe trial runbook + scorer alignment

Looping in a few operational details and answering Olivia’s questions:

- Scoring: yes, we can make the nightly scorer use a custom weighted-F1 that emphasizes medication precision. We’ll expose weights in the scoring config (example: med_weight=0.6, entity_weight=0.4).
- CSV spec: UTF-8, comma-delimited, headers required: note_id, note_text, encounter_type, timestamp, gold_entities (JSON array string), reviewer_id (optional). See attached sample: medscribe_eval_dataset_sample.csv.
- Validation: Our ingestion job will run a quick schema check. If anything fails we'll surface row-level errors back to eng@medsprint.ai.
- Sandbox endpoints: Jasmine — can you confirm we will enable per-customer model pinning? MedScribe asked for pinned 13B quant + fallback 7B quant on capacity failure.

One more ops ask: if MedScribe intends to run continuous nightly evaluation over the 2-week trial, we should set a quota and retention window. Suggest: 14 days retention for raw request logs + 90 days for aggregated metrics. Olivia — confirm if that matches your SOC requirements.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Got it — thanks all. Olivia: small follow-ups before the 8/19 dataset drop:

- Please name the file medscribe_eval_200_anon.csv and ensure gold_entities is a JSON string with entity spans and labels (the sample shows the format).
- We will enable model pinning for the trial and configure a fallback policy to the 7B quant variant; I’ll share the pinning config in the kickoff doc.
- Retention: the suggested retention (14d raw, 90d aggregated) aligns with our baseline; if you need longer we can discuss a retention add-on.

Kickoff invite is out for Tue 8/24 10:00am PT. Agenda: ingestion checklist (10m), scoring config & weights (15m), run cadence & alerts (10m), Q&A (5m).

Thanks — looking forward to the trial.
Jasmine

Attachments referenced: medscribe_eval_dataset_sample.csv, medscribe_prompt_bank_v1.md, redwood-onramp-checklist.pdf
